body.message:
Here's the full cost breakdown for your client, Maria:

Security deposit: AED 2,000 (refundable within 14 working days after check-out)
First + last month upfront: AED 24,000
Total on day one: AED 26,000, then AED 12,000/month from month 2

On the 3-month question, the rate is locked at AED 12,000 for months 1 to 3. Months 4 to 6 get reviewed based on market at that point, but we confirm the new rate before it kicks in. Is she happy to go ahead on that basis?
